description: What may be published in the KotoR2 repository folder and in the release zips, and where each kind of file comes from. tools/check_provenance.py enforces it (the same checker and rules as KotOR 1). Add a rule here, with its origin, in the same commit as any new kind of file. The repository holds source only: compiled scripts (.ncs) and the extender DLL are built into the release zips. Nothing derived from the game is published: models, textures, tables, archives, audio, templates copied from the game, the game's scripts and nwscript.nss. tools/stage_publish.py builds the candidate repository folder from the project and runs this check on it before anything is copied to the GitHub folder.

allowed.origin: authored: project documentation (a document that quotes the game's text must be reviewed by a person before it is added)
authored: the Archipelago client (AI-assisted, human-reviewed); no game data inside
authored: build and check tools; no game data inside
authored: the rules of the provenance check
authored: tables of identifiers (tags, ids, gate ids, short location names); the check refuses prose fields
authored: tables of identifiers; the check refuses prose fields
authored: tables of identifiers and addresses (facts about the game, no game text)

authored: our NWScript source (generated or hand-written). The game's own scripts and nwscript.nss are never stored here; a script that reuses the name of a game script is our own text written for that slot
authored: build file of the extender
authored: the K2 extender export list
third-party licence text: nwnsc (MIT) and its compiler library (BSD-3)

binaries.origin: nwnsc 1.1.5, downloaded unchanged from https://github.com/nwneetools/nwnsc/releases (nwnsc-win-v1.1.5.zip), the same file KotOR 1 ships. Added to the release zip when it is built; the repository does not hold it
